logger.doc:name: Log Start
logger.message: [Customer Process API] Aggregating profile for customer: #[vars.customerId]

logger.doc:name: Log Sys1 Offline
logger.message: [Customer Process API] Demographics Sys API unreachable. Using fallback sample for #[vars.customerId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { customerId: vars.customerId, firstName: if (vars.customerId == "CUST-1002") "Jane" else if (vars.customerId == "CUST-1003") "Robert" else "John", lastName: if (vars.customerId == "CUST-1002") "Smith" else if (vars.customerId == "CUST-1003") "Taylor" else "Doe", email: if (vars.customerId == "CUST-1002") "jane.smith@example.com" else "john.doe@example.com", phone: "+1-555-234-5678", dateOfBirth: "1988-06-15", address: { street: "123 Financial Way", city: "New York", state: "NY", postalCode: "10001", country: "USA" }, status: "ACTIVE" }

logger.doc:name: Log Sys2 Offline
logger.message: [Customer Process API] Accounts Sys API unreachable. Using fallback sample for #[vars.customerId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if (vars.customerId == "CUST-1001") [ { accountId: "ACC-900123", accountNumber: "100098234123", accountType: "CHECKING", balance: 35000.00, currency: "USD", status: "ACTIVE" }, { accountId: "ACC-900124", accountNumber: "100098234124", accountType: "INVESTMENT", balance: 75000.50, currency: "USD", status: "ACTIVE" } ] else if (vars.customerId == "CUST-1002") [ { accountId: "ACC-900125", accountNumber: "100098234125", accountType: "SAVINGS", balance: 32000.00, currency: "USD", status: "ACTIVE" } ] else if (vars.customerId == "CUST-1003") [ { accountId: "ACC-900126", accountNumber: "100098234126", accountType: "SAVINGS", balance: 8500.00, currency: "USD", status: "ACTIVE" } ] else [ { accountId: "ACC-900127", accountNumber: "100098234127", accountType: "CHECKING", balance: 1250.00, currency: "USD", status: "ACTIVE" } ]
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), status: 404, error: "Not Found", message: "Customer with ID " ++ (vars.customerId default "") ++ " not found", correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Not Found
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Customer Process API] Customer not found: " ++ (vars.customerId default "")]

ee:transform.doc:name: Consolidate & Categorize (Type A, B, C, D)

logger.doc:name: Log Completion
logger.message: [Customer Process API] Customer #[vars.customerId] categorized as Type: #[payload.classification.customerType]

logger.doc:name: Log Onboard
logger.message: [Customer Process API] Initiating onboarding flow for: #[payload.customer.email]

logger.doc:name: Log Sys1 Error
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Customer Process API] Demographics API call failed: " ++ (error.description default "")]

http:request.doc:name: POST /accounts
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { accountNumber: "1000" ++ (randomInt(90000000) + 10000000) as String, customerId: vars.createdCustomerId, accountType: vars.incomingPayload.initialAccount.accountType default "SAVINGS", balance: vars.incomingPayload.initialAccount.initialDeposit default 1000.00, currency: vars.incomingPayload.initialAccount.currency default "INR", branchCode: vars.incomingPayload.initialAccount.branchCode default "BR-MAIN" }]

logger.doc:name: Log Sys2 Error
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Customer Process API] Accounts API call failed: " ++ (error.description default "")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var genAccountId = "ACC-" ++ (randomInt(900000) + 100000) as String --- { accountId: genAccountId, account: { accountId: genAccountId, accountNumber: "1000" ++ (randomInt(90000000) + 10000000) as String, customerId: vars.createdCustomerId, accountType: vars.incomingPayload.initialAccount.accountType default "SAVINGS", balance: vars.incomingPayload.initialAccount.initialDeposit default 1000.00, currency: vars.incomingPayload.initialAccount.currency default "INR", status: "ACTIVE" } }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var initialDeposit = (vars.accountData.balance default 0.00) as Number var curr = vars.accountData.currency default "INR" var balInINR = if (upper(curr) == "USD") (initialDeposit * 95.80) else initialDeposit var cType = if (balInINR >= 5000000) "A" else if (balInINR >= 1000000) "B" else if (balInINR >= 200000) "C" else "D" --- { customerId: vars.createdCustomerId, fullName: (vars.demographicsData.firstName default "") ++ " " ++ (vars.demographicsData.lastName default ""), demographics: (vars.demographicsData default {}) ++ { customerId: vars.createdCustomerId }, accounts: [vars.accountData], financialSummary: { totalAccounts: 1, totalBalance: initialDeposit, currency: curr }, classification: { customerType: cType, tierName: if (cType == "A") "Platinum / High Net Worth" else if (cType == "B") "Gold / Affluent" else if (cType == "C") "Silver / Mass Market" else "Bronze / Basic", tierBenefits: if (cType == "A") ["Dedicated Relationship Manager", "Zero Wire Fees"] else if (cType == "B") ["Priority Support", "Discounted Forex", "Fee Waiver"] else if (cType == "C") ["Standard Banking", "Free Alerts"] else ["Basic Savings", "Digital Card"], evaluatedAt: now() } }
